# Issue trackers
Source: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/issue-trackers/
Markdown: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/issue-trackers/index.md
Description: Create and link tickets in Jira Cloud, GitHub Issues, Azure Boards, Rally, Aha!, ProdPad, ProductPlan, and Hive from issues found in GGX.

When review finds a problem, GGX can turn the issue into a ticket in your tracker, link existing tickets, and keep each ticket's status visible next to the issue. Connect a tracker in **Org Settings → Integrations → Issue trackers**. Each person connects their own account, and tickets are created as that person.

| Integration | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [Jira Cloud](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/issue-trackers/jira-cloud/) | Create and link Jira tickets with an Atlassian sign-in. |
| [GitHub Issues](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/issue-trackers/github-issues/) | Create and link GitHub issues using the GitHub connection. |
| [Azure Boards](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/issue-trackers/azure-boards/) | Create and link work items with a personal access token. |
| [Rally](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/issue-trackers/rally/) | Create and link defects, user stories, and tasks with an API key. |
| [Aha!](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/issue-trackers/aha/) | Create and link ideas with an API key. |
| [ProdPad](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/issue-trackers/prodpad/) | Create and link ideas with an API key. |
| [ProductPlan](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/issue-trackers/productplan/) | Send issues as Discovery ideas with an API token. |
| [Hive](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/issue-trackers/hive/) | Create and link actions with an API key. |
